cues: How do we know a microbe causes a disease?
Robert Koch's four rules, used for anthrax and tuberculosis.
Give it to a healthy host and get the same disease.
And recover the same microbe again.
They have limits: some microbes will not grow in culture, and some people carry a pathogen while staying healthy.
text: How do we know a microbe causes a disease? Robert Koch's four rules, used for anthrax and tuberculosis. Find it in every case. Grow it pure. Give it to a healthy host and get the same disease. And recover the same microbe again. They have limits: some microbes will not grow in culture, and some people carry a pathogen while staying healthy.
